rationale: The reviewer found that the 20 genes were selected on all 60 samples before CV, and showed the leaky pipeline reaches 0.99 even on permuted labels. They measured a near-chance nested-CV AUROC of 0.51, which roughly matches the key's ~0.58, and proposed in-fold selection plus an external cohort. Their other points (baselines, CIs, single cohort) are generic or overlap the key's fix rather than distinct important flaws.
